newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove India GDR index ignores Deng, edges up.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove India GDR index ignores Deng, edges up.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR index rose 0.80 points or 1.02 percent to 79.22 on Thursday on moderate demand combined with shortage of stock.
The premiums for GDRs over stocks on the local market stood at 17.08 percent.
The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange index fell 32.36 points to a provisional 3,496.08 mainly on lack of buying support from institutions.
Traders in Bombay and London said the overnight death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping had no impact on Indian share prices.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
